CustomField.description: Count of Vehicles currently assigned to this Showroom. NOTE: Vehicle.Showroom__c is a Lookup, not Master-Detail (a Vehicle shouldn't be deleted just because its Showroom is), so this can't be a native Roll-Up Summary. Maintained by a Stage 8 Flow on Vehicle create/update/delete instead. Starts at 0 and stays inert (the Showroom capacity validation rule will never block) until that Flow exists — see DISCOVERY_LOG.md.
CustomField.label: Vehicle Count
